source_unit: HHS/ACF LIHEAP Performance Management API; selected state grant recipients

field_ids.426: Restoration of Service Due to Disconnection - All Occurrences
field_ids.473: Prevention of Service Loss Due to Bill Payment Issues - All Occurrences

interpretation.safe_result: Selected states show materially different reported occurrence volumes relative to the number of households served in the same preliminary FY2025 reporting surface.
interpretation.derived_measure_label: occurrences per served household diagnostic; not a service-loss rate, prevention probability, or household outcome rate
not_established: unique households experiencing restoration or prevention
interpretation.counterinterpretation: Differences may reflect state program design, reporting rules, fuel mix, crisis definitions, funding, case mix, repeat occurrences, or preliminary data quality—not different causal program effects.

boundary: This is a selected-state descriptive diagnostic designed to expose denominator and occurrence-unit differences; it is not a cross-state effectiveness ranking.
